name: zoe-waterpump-reset
label: Zoe water pump counter reset
description: Reads then clears the four driving water-pump time counters.
warning: Erases the water pump run-time counters. Irreversible, and it destroys the service history the counters represent.
_unverified: Not run against a vehicle. Slug and request names are checked against the database; the effect is not.
_substitution: The original names EVC_3180_RH5_510_V1.1_20210422T184714, which this database snapshot does not carry. Pointed at EVC_3180_RH5_170_V1.0 instead — the same module at a different version, which does define all four counter requests. Unverified.
